## Learnings
- Ground strips with a grey top area: 3/6 with the style reference leaked the reference's blurred town into the empty grey. Without the reference + an explicit hex backdrop the result was clean and still on-style. Walls/trackbed (frame fully filled) never leaked.
- Walls/trackbed came out more "game tile" than painterly; acceptable since they sit at the tilt-shift blur edge.

## Processing (`docs/art/tools/t31_build.cjs`, `t31_lib.cjs`)
- Seamless: `seamless()` searches the cut column (60%…100% width) whose 48-px window best matches the left edge, then cross-fades 48 px → keeps brick/sleeper period intact (no ghosting). Checked by tiling 2× (`t31_preview.cjs`, contact sheet).
- Walls: top 50% of the frame (grass lip + courses), opaque. Ground: grey keyed with `t10_keylib` (bg sampled from the top rows), cropped to the fence top. Trackbed: full frame, opaque — sleepers run vertically; DEV may squash it vertically.
- Sheets: local keyer, split by alpha column gaps, trimmed (4 px pad); lens ≤ 900 px tall, planters 600 px tall. Kept painterly (not pixelized) like `l<n>_near`.
- Finals via `npx tsx scripts/optimize-assets.ts` → `assets/scenery/*.png|webp` (19 × 2 files).
